filename_tr: Our children and the prayer — 'Abd al-Malik ibn Qasim. [epub]
description: This book emphasizes the importance of teaching prayer to children from an early age, using Quranic verses and prophetic traditions as a foundation. It provides specific guidelines for parents, such as introducing prayer at seven years old and gradually increasing discipline by ten. The text highlights spiritual benefits for both parents and children, encouraging fathers to set a righteous example and seek divine guidance in parenting.
